Senses.Explanation: A bodily image of immense capacity: carrying Mount Sumeru on the back, commonly paired with holding up the sun and moon or swallowing the sea. Yuanwu Keqin supplies the breakthrough capacity sequence deployment through direct capacity sequence after breaking through the iron gate. Shanhui Huan supplies the hall-address immense capacity deployment through direct hall-address sequence paired with holding the great sea. Dayu Xingtao supplies the challenge and counterchallenge deployment through direct challenge pairing the monk swallowing the sea with the master carrying Sumeru. Yuan'an Liao supplies the attainment sequence deployment through direct attainment sequence paired with holding up sun and moon.
